selection_boundary.decision_rule: Record active consequential judgment where legitimate alternatives remained and the choice establishes, changes, applies with discretion, excepts, or supersedes guidance that future work may need to understand.
selection_boundary.mechanical_rule: Do not record a mechanical derivation: when competent contributors accepting the same governing decisions and evidence have only one valid outcome, record the task, implementation consequence, test, or pull request instead.
